parsed.explanation: The inference from “at most one positive value” to V⊆{0,c} ignores possible negative values. Although (4) supplies the needed repair, the proof never states it: if g(x)=d<0, induction along the forward orbit gives f^n(x)=x+nd>0 for every n, impossible for sufficiently large n. Thus nonnegativity of g, required by L5.3 and used in the subsequent dichotomy, is not established as written.
